name: football-stats
description: Brasileirão Action Zones: see which Série A player leads each zone of the pitch for passes, shots and more.
author: Felipe Garcia

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w server && npm run test:coverage -w client
